bio

about

Havre De Grace is the musical alias of singer-songwriter Stefan Auvache Bradley.

"I love music and music loves me. I can't help but play the guitar and write songs. It is my favorite thing to do in the world. Havre De Grace is the vehicle I use to share what I love with anyone willing to listen."

Stefan's debut album "I Want to Be Yours and Other Songs" was released in 2025.
